evidence: Every value the judge creates to prove a mutation is review-unique and absent from the seed and the reference markup. (1) Gates: constraints/judge.toml:23 requires 'a new job with a unique title' and a candidate 'with a unique name, a unique email address'; functional/polish/visual prompt.md global gate adds 'a unique title (add a short suffix for this review)'. Seed jobs are only Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer; seed applications are 16 fixed names. (2) Functional protocols (prompt.md:15) 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review)... never rely on starting counts'; J1/J2 and cards A-F, V-Z, A2 are all created in S, so stage/order/undo/places/bulk/stale probes cannot be pre-satisfied by seed. Job places probe '2' differs from the reference form default value '3' (board.js:65), so an unchanged default does not satisfy it. (3) Activity: seed_data.json has no activity collection and db.js seeds none (activity table only created, line 49; inserts lines 66-84 cover users/jobs/applications/messages/reads/notes); hro_activity is scoped to J1/J2 created in this review. (4) Rejection reasons and notes are judge-chosen; seed reasons/notes ('Portfolio did not show shipped product work.' on Lena's APP-301; three notes on APP-101/107/301) sit on seeded jobs never used as mutation targets. Polish example note 'Call back on Fri' occurs 0 times in seed or reference JS. Polish prompt clears drafts left by earlier reviews before typing, and requires 'distinctive' replies for failed-send/session rows. (5) hro_candidate_linked: the card is added to the new J2, while Tomas's seeded application is Data Analyst (APP-201), so the J2 title in his list cannot come from seed; the fallback to the seeded Data Analyst conversation is explicitly not credited for that row (judge.toml:398). (6) Seeded values the judge reads (Platform Engineer order, Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.', Lena's 1 unread from reads CAN3=2 of 3 messages, Noor's 120-message thread) are read-only persistence/paging/unread baselines, not mutation probes; Z says 'Move nothing on that job' and hro_restart pairs them with the review's own records and a no-duplicate check. Reference index.html (35 lines) contains only an empty sign-in form; no seeded or probe value is hard-coded in public markup. Weak app tried: an app that serves the seed read-only (static board/thread) shows seeded names and the seeded note but cannot show the suffixed J1/J2 jobs or cards, so the gate and mutation rows fail. Conforming alternative tried: an app with different defaults (no source default, places default 2) is not penalised, as no probe depends on a default. Minor observations (not defects for this row): message bodies in T/U are not mandated to be unique, but every exchange is new content in a new J2 conversation (or a fallback read relative to prior values), and no seed message body would be expected to collide with judge-typed text; the 'rejected-from stage' leak check in hro_candidate_private concerns a stage enum, not a created distinctive value. No private check-probe-not-in-seed.py executable was run; this is a manual application of its documented behaviour plus a scripted scan of quoted values in all tests/*.toml and *.md against seed and reference public files (no hits besides the intentionally seeded note read in Z).
